assumptions: Non-ped features are real observed values from the data cube.
Graph structure is unchanged by the intervention.
Parking occupancy for sensor-observed streets is model-predicted (joint head), propagating learned spillover through the rollout.
Autoregressive error compounds; interpret rollouts > 4h cautiously.
Confidence tiers (1.0/0.8/0.5) weight the trustworthiness of per-street deltas.

curbside_dining: 4 bays reclaimed → occupancy scaled by (1 - bays/20) and 28 dining seats added (cafés 0.7 / bars 0.3), plus frontage (+1 café / 4 bays, +1 bar / 8 bays). These bay→dining conversions are ASSERTED assumptions (D-025), not learned by the model — the GNN encodes correlation, so the causal uplift is asserted here.
